suggestions.rationale: Clinical Mapping Master Batch 2026 publishes this relationship only as temporal association risk. suggestions.rationale: Clinical Mapping Master Batch 2026 publishes this relationship only as treatment complication. Require antiresorptive exposure such as bisphosphonate or denosumab for osteoporosis before medication-related osteonecrosis of the jaw; confirm MRONJ diagnostic criteria. Treatment complication, not an effect of osteoporosis itself. The cited literature supports only this bounded proposition and does not, by itself, establish an individual medical nexus.
